decisions.reason: The package still requires a signed, PE-stamped concurrence letter; replacing its signature-block placeholder with the PE's full legal name does not change the package's existing presentation, stamp, or signature requirements.
Correcting the PE name in the signature block does not alter the limited review scope or required review outcome.
The signature-block correction does not change the documentation required to verify the modified electrical work.
The source concerns attribution on the Nevada concurrence letter and does not resolve or modify the separate California credential requirement or its existing ambiguity.
The Nevada concurrence-letter signature-block correction does not change the separate additional project's permit-ready electrical drawing or stamping requirements.
Correcting the PE name on the Nevada concurrence letter does not affect the electrical calculation scope for the additional permit project.
The signature-block name correction is unrelated to the HVAC sizing, Title 24, and Manual J, S, and D calculation requirements.
